# Pinned Compose corner shapes

The 22 `.kt` files are unchanged Apache-2.0 AndroidX sources at revision
`a095da93f8e98dea8748ceed79ea8427aade245f`. `sources.json` records exact URLs and
SHA-256 hashes. The sources retain their original license headers.

`outline-oracle.json.gz` contains original-body JVM outline/containment results;
generation, coverage and explicit host/rendering boundaries are documented in
[`tools/androidx-corner-shapes/README.md`](../../../../tools/androidx-corner-shapes/README.md).
